title: Note about the Next Lesson - Packages and Imports
summary: Short article warning that the next video uses the old Material UI v4 package names; the current MUI v5 packages and import paths must be used instead.

concepts.heading: Use MUI v5 packages, not the ones in the video
points: The video installs the legacy @material-ui/core 4.6.1 and @material-ui/icons 4.5.1. These are superseded.

Add four dependencies to package.json instead: @mui/material, @mui/icons-material (both ^5.15.11), plus the styling engine @emotion/react (^11.11.4) and @emotion/styled (^11.11.0). Run npm install afterwards.
Imports change: icons come from @mui/icons-material/<Name>, components from @mui/material (named imports such as { Fab } and { Zoom }) rather than per-file default imports.
Using the new names avoids console warnings and errors, and matches the downloadable finished projects.
(Extra) MUI v5 needs Emotion as its default styling engine, which is why the two @emotion packages are listed.

pitfalls: Copying the old @material-ui imports from the video causes dependency or peer-version errors with current React.
Forgetting the @emotion packages gives a missing-module error when MUI components render.
